import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    idx = 0
    t = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
    out = []
    for _ in range(t):
        n = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
        a = data[idx:idx + n]
        idx += n
        a = list(map(int, a))
        best = a[0]
        prev = a[0]
        for i in range(1, n):
            x = a[i]
            if (x - a[i - 1]) % 2 != 0:
                cur = prev + x if prev + x > x else x
            else:
                cur = x
            prev = cur
            if cur > best:
                best = cur
        out.append(str(best))
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out) + "\n")

    out = []

    for _ in range(t):
        n = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
        arr = data[idx:idx+n]; idx += n
        best = [NEG, NEG]  # best[0]: ending with even, best[1]: ending with odd

            v = int(x)
            q = v & 1
            other = best[1 - q]
            prev = other if other > 0 else 0
            cur = v + prev
            best[q] = cur
            if cur > ans:
                ans = cur
        out.append(str(ans))
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out) + "\n")
